title: PerchRL: Vision-Based Agile Perching on Inclined Platforms under Rapid and Irregular Motion
abstract: arXiv:2606.03441v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Autonomous vision-based perching of quadrotors on moving inclined platforms is critical for air-ground collaboration but remains challenging due to the limited field of view (FOV). In this paper, we propose PerchRL, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for vision-based agile perching on inclined platforms under rapid and irregular motion. Specifically, we employ a two-stage learning strategy consisting of state-based pre-training followed by vision-based fine-tuning. To improve generalization across diverse platform motions, we employ randomized platform trajectories to prevent overfitting and temporal augmentation methods to capture latent motion patterns from historical observations. During vision-based fine-tuning, a hybrid learning framework consisting of visibility-aware state augmentation and active perception rewards is presented to improve robustness under intermittent visual loss. translated_title: PerchRL：基于视觉的无人机在快速不规则运动倾斜平台上的敏捷降落
translated_abstract: 四旋翼无人机基于视觉自主降落在移动的倾斜平台上，对空地协同至关重要，但由于视场角（FOV）有限，这一任务仍然极具挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了PerchRL，一个用于在快速且不规则运动的倾斜平台上实现基于视觉敏捷降落的强化学习（RL）框架。具体而言，我们采用两阶段学习策略，即先进行基于状态的预训练，再进行基于视觉的微调。为了提升在不同平台运动下的泛化能力，我们采用随机化的平台轨迹来防止过拟合，并利用时序增强方法从历史观测中捕捉潜在的运动模式。在基于视觉的微调阶段，我们提出了一种由可见性感知状态增强和主动感知奖励组成的混合学习框架，以提高间歇性视觉丢失情况下的鲁棒性。大量的仿真和真实世界（实验验证，原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出PerchRL强化学习框架，通过“状态预训练+视觉微调”的两阶段策略、随机化平台轨迹与时序增强提升泛化能力，并结合可见性感知状态增强与主动感知奖励，实现了四旋翼无人机在快速不规则运动倾斜平台上的基于视觉的敏捷降落。
en_tdlr: PerchRL is a reinforcement learning framework enabling vision-based agile perching of quadrotors on rapidly and irregularly moving inclined platforms, combining two-stage state-to-vision learning, randomized trajectories with temporal augmentation, and visibility-aware state augmentation with active perception rewards for robustness under intermittent visual loss.
